Chooses x/y = constant over xy, x+y and x-y: a straight statement of the constant-ratio definition of direct proportion.
x proportional to y with x1/y1 = x2/y2 gives y2 = 2 x 210 / 5 = 84. The equation solved is the constancy of the ratio itself, not a whole-number multiplier.
Scale 1:300 means the actual distance is the map distance times 300, giving 1200 km. A fixed multiplier carried straight across, as petrol-to-distance does.
Cost of 4 m from cost of 10 m of cloth: total amount spent against quantity purchased, which is the instance this concept names.
15 books weigh 6 kg so 6 books weigh 6 x (6/15) = 2.4 kg - the ratio 6/15 carried across to the weight unchanged. Not a spending question, so not 31458.
18 kg over 12 days scaled by 9/12 gives 13.5 kg; the multiplier passes from days to quantity eaten unchanged.
3 knives cost Rs 63 so 17 cost Rs 357: amount spent against number of articles bought, the example this concept is built on.
20 cows equal 15 oxen, so 36 oxen (a factor of 36/15) need 20 x 36/15 = 48 cows. More oxen means more cows - direct, with the multiplier carried across.

The same field reaped by 6 women instead of 18 takes 18 x 7 / 6 = 21 days. The job is held fixed and the workforce changed, which is what separates this from the general more-workers-less-time statement.
One tank filled by 5 pipes instead of 6 takes 6 x 60 / 5 = 72 minutes. The pipes are the workforce and the tank is the fixed job.
x = ky with y = 4, x = 8 gives k = 2: finding the constant of proportionality is finding the ratio that stays the same.
Varying inversely, xy = 15 x 6 = 90, so y = 15 gives x = 6. The constant product is the inverse-proportion definition.
432 km on 36 litres gives 300 km on 25 litres - literally the petrol-consumption-against-distance case, the multiplier carrying across.
Cost of 36 bags from the cost of 27 bags of paddy: money spent against number of articles.
At a fixed 75 km/hr, distance scales with time: 75 x 36/60 = 45 km. Speed is held constant, so this is direct scaling and not the speed-against-time inverse case of 31467.
60 km in 1 hour gives 150 km in 2.5 hours. Speed fixed, so time scales directly with distance by the multiplier 150/60.
One trench dug by 3 men instead of 10 takes 10 x 15 / 3 = 50 days - fixed job, altered workforce.
40 acres scaled by 18/4 men and by 12/30 days gives 72 acres. The multiplier is carried across unchanged, applied once for each factor.
2:x = 1:2 gives x = 4, then x:y = 2:3 gives y = 6. Both steps solve for an unknown by holding a ratio constant.

Every option offers a pair that moves together (side and area, the two free angles, area and diameter) and invites the reader to call it proportional. That is exactly the wrong generalisation this concept exists to block. NOTE: the marked key 'All of these' is wrong - see report.
x = 2,7,11 against y = 8,28,44 gives y/x = 4 throughout, so the pair is direct because the ratio is constant - the definition, applied to a table.
Commission on Rs 100 is the commission on Rs 1000 divided by ten. One multiplier carried straight from sales to commission.
5 bottles per 6 children scaled to 15 bottles gives 18 children - the threefold multiplier carried across unchanged, this concept's exact shape.
Rs 806 for 13 days is Rs 62 a day, so Rs 1798 buys 29 days. Pay and days scale by the same factor.
Four times the dust takes four times the days: 15 becomes 60. The multiplier carries across unchanged, exactly as threefold consumption gives threefold distance.
